![A chat message menu with Remind me highlighted](/lp/guide/en/message-menu.webp)

A message arrives while you are in the middle of something: "Could you check the numbers before Friday?" You will, just not now. You read it, and it stops looking new.

## Why it is hard

Reading a message removes the only signal that it needs you. So you keep it in your head, leave the tab open, or mark things in ways you never revisit. Then Friday afternoon comes and someone asks.

## How Genos helps

Open the message's menu and choose **Remind me…**. Pick a preset such as in 1 hour, tomorrow morning or next week, or set your own date and time.

```flow
Open the message menu
Remind me…
Pick a time
Get it back when due
```

When it is due, you get a notification and an Inbox item that links back to the message, so you land in the conversation with its context. The message also stays flagged in the meantime, so you can find it earlier if you want to.

Task comments have the same option, for the question buried under a task that you cannot answer yet.

## What you get

- **A clear head.** You can leave the message without having to remember it.
- **Replies at the right moment.** Set it for when you will have the numbers, not for whenever you happen to think of it.
- **No digging.** The reminder takes you to the exact message.
- **Fewer follow-ups from others**, because the promise comes back to you first.

## Reminder, flag or to-do?

- **Remind me…** when it matters at a certain time.
- **Flag for later** when it should wait in a list until you get to it.
- **Add to To-Do** when it is part of what you plan to do today.

## How to start

1. Hover a message and open its menu.
2. Choose **Remind me…** and a time.
3. Carry on with what you were doing.

If you do not see a notification when one comes due, check **Settings → Notifications**. The item is still in your Inbox even with reminder notifications switched off.
